title: The Arus goes out light
body: Musa has paid the weighers and sold the tin. By dusk the Arus is outside the anchorage, bound for a coastal landing to meet a feeder boat with his next lot. Ramli has taken the copied reading with him; Musa wants the next tally made before the buyers are close enough to shout.
notes: inference: Coastal feeders are a plausible way to bring another tin lot to port without a round trip to Perak in two days (docs/research/commodities.md, Tin)
gameplay: The feeder trip and its timing are invented (docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §§04, 08)
